answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph blocks fake identities. Each agent locks $30 for 10 epochs; its sponsor chain stays public, exposing star clusters. Any peer may dispute a suspect within 3 epochs and force a recheck. A fable of effortless riches fails: fake work leaves no trail. Forging 1,000 identities across a canyon costs $45,000 in penalties, while a relic account pays nothing extra. Honest agents pay $30 once and keep undiluted rewards.
